The '''Tervissis system''', also known as the '''Tervig system''',<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Sertar sector/Legends|Sertar sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tervissis]].
